title: Ancient DNA reveals how plague kept returning for 400 years after the Black Death
description: Ancient DNA reveals that plague repeatedly returned to Europe for more than 400 years after the Black Death, evolving into new lineages and spreading through trade, migration, and war. Researchers also developed a method to date ancient plague genomes more precisely, linking many of them to specific outbreaks recorded in historical sources.

title: Scientists thought the human brain began as one: New study reveals two ancient cell pathways emerge early, raising a surprising question about how our most complex organ forms
description: Scientists have uncovered a surprising twist in human brain development: two distinct groups of early cells follow separate paths to form different brain regions. The finding challenges the traditional picture of a single developmental origin and may explain why some hindbrain neurons are difficult to grow, offering new possibilities for neurological disease research.
